descriptions: Added a call life cycle, new to accepted to on scene to closed with a closing reason, configured under Config.Dispatch.Lifecycle
Added Config.Dispatch.Priorities, which drives the chip colour, list sorting, blip scale and the sound played when an alert arrives
Added the live map beside the call list on /dispatch/alerts, with focus in both directions between a card and its pin
Added quick actions on the on-screen alert under Config.Dispatch.QuickActions, GPS stays on the existing FastGPS key
Added Create call in the tablet under Config.Dispatch.CreateCall, with grade gates checked on the server as well as in the interface
Added caller details and attachments under Config.Dispatch.Calls, plus a CreateCitizenCall export for phone and panic button resources
Added the archive under Config.Dispatch.History, writing to qf_mdt_police_v2_dispatch_calls and qf_mdt_police_v2_dispatch_call_officers, both created automatically on first start
Added a sidebar counter of unassigned calls under Config.Dispatch.SidebarBadge
Added Font Awesome icons inside map pins, set per type in Config.Map.AlertSettings or per call through the new icon field
Added police station icons and ring colours under Config.Map.PoliceStationDefaults
Added the officer commands /panic and /location under Config.Dispatch.OfficerCommands, with name, badge and position read on the server so none of it can be spoofed
Added the civilian line /911 under Config.Dispatch.CitizenCalls, rate limited on cooldown, per-session cap, repeated text and another call already made nearby
Changed the react counter into a real assignment, the old dispatch/alerts/react endpoint still works and maps onto it, set Config.Dispatch.Lifecycle.enabled to false to keep the 1.9.x behaviour
Removed server/dispatch-compatibility.lua from escrow_ignore so it can be edited, with a copy-paste template at the top of the file
